这个估值还要求 AMD 在 28年继续增长 35%、29年增长 25%，长期自由现金流率最终提高至30%左右。
也就是说，你现在买入 AMD，你买的是，AMD 在未来几年增长预期超过这个数据。

所以，一方面，AMD 要看 GPU 实际出货、经营利润和现金流能否持续超过市场预期。
另一方面，要看盈利上修的幅度，能否覆盖利率和风险溢价带来的估值压力。

items.new_information: 新增业务转型、累计回购及以收入与坏账验证代币价值的投资框架

evidence.quote: 原来做Zignaly、ZIGChain的团队，今年统一品牌为ZIGFinance，10月又宣布逐步关闭老投资平台，把资源集中到金融产品的发起、设计和分销上。
从投资平台、做链，到现在做RWA，一直在求变。它想做的生意，说白了就是帮资产方找钱：资产方需要融资，投资者想找收益，ZIGMarkets参与产品设计，再通过机构和合作平台分销，从设计、分销和后续服务中收取费用。能不能翻身，还得看新生意有没有人买单、能赚多少钱。
新的业务重心已经不是通用公链，，落在受监管的金融产品上。当前最硬是牌照与合作方名单，ZIG这次转型明显瞄准中东市场，尤其是海湾地区的企业融资需求，Markets的受监管业务通过南非持牌实体开展，受FSCA按FAIS法案监管。

业务与 ethereum:0xb2617246d0c6c0087f18703d576831899ca94f01  的联系，主要是利润回购。按照最新模型，Markets用部分收入每月在公开市场买入$ZIG，长期累计目标为5亿枚。一半进入生态池，另一半由验证人投票，决定永久退出流通，还是同样进池。也就是说没每多发一只产品，就多一次赚取费用的机会。能不能形成持续买盘，还得看实际收入和回购金额。目前公开的回购是4次合计5.37M枚。
理论上，可以把ZIG理解为新兴市场私募信贷上链的一张看涨期权。关键还是业务规模以及控制坏账，最终把业务变成持续的收入和回购代币。

evidence.quote: TL;DR: a stop has nothing to do with whether the asset is good. It is what happens when the loss budget runs out, decided while you could still think straight. Your reason 1 already is a stop, you just do not call it one. hXXI hit its stop at 76K in March and a 23% BTC drawdown became 30 bps.

Then there is the capital that is not ours. A vault epoch carries a loss budget investors subscribed to. hXXI stopped its long delta at 76K in the March selloff, a 23% BTC drawdown, and closed the epoch within 30 bps. Without the stop the book carried long delta to 66K, far past the loss budget. Holding through because the asset might be "worth holding"

Returns compound geometrically. A 50% loss needs 100% to recover, and open-ended losses on a positive expectancy book still go to zero if the bet size is large enough relative to the edge. The stop puts a floor under the loss distribution. It is not a put: it pays for the floor in forgone rebounds instead of premium, and it can gap. For a short vol book with

Where we agree: a stop at a chart level with no vol input and no loss budget is theatre. A stop inside the bid-ask noise is a donation to the market maker. A stop wider than the position's maximum loss is not a stop. The fix is a better stop, computed off vol and the remaining budget.
Our hXXI strategy is the best BTC yield we know of on chain, and the stop is part of the reason we can say that with a straight face.

evidence.quote: Since Kamino Fixed Rates launched, $85M+ in fixed-rate loans have been originated across 30-day terms, with over $35M rolled into new terms through Auto Rollover.
Variable borrow rates adjust with market utilization, which means a carry strategy can turn unprofitable when borrowing costs rise sharply.
Kamino Fixed Rates brings the financing terms institutions rely on onchain, with a borrow rate locked for a defined term no matter what happens in the variable reserves.
Every rate and term runs as its own isolated reserve, and Auto Rollover renews loans into new terms when lending capital is available, so strategies keep running on a known cost of capital.

items.new_information: 指出执法缺位使链上法律保护难落地

evidence.quote: It’s not really a legal problem anymore, it’s an adverse selection problem combined with a free rider problem.

First, who wants to play the role of the policeman and the public prosecutor? The role of a policeman is thankless. The public prosecutor is friendless by design. Both must be funded by the public purse - which does not exist in our industry.

So you could have the best legal protections on paper and you would do nothing if they were breached because the team wields immense commercial influence over the foundation structure which protects your rights or in the case of a capital formation platform, the platform has to sue its own founders which is commercially a non starter.

The alternative of course is that you try and enforce your rights yourself which is again, not viable. If you held 1m worth of a 100m market cap token and your rights were infringed, lawyering up would cost you 50-100k to even get an initial view. Actually taking action would cost you a couple hundred grand in the first phase, and you would likely be dragged

into arbitration in the islands. You will burn a million in the first year trying to enforce your rights against the structure that supposedly granted it because the powers that be don’t really want you to. Don't get me started on the fact that all your lawyers would likely be commercially conflicted, if not actually conflicted from acting for you, due to
Rights without anyone to enforce the rights are worthless.

items.summary: 据dotey整理的对谈，Anthropic每日合并的代码变更从5月约2500次增至9月超过3万次。Addy Osmani称，改动先由Claude实测审查并自动修复，人只看录屏、截图等验证证据。
items.author: dotey
items.event: Anthropic AI代码合并与验证流程
items.new_information: 日合并量增至3万次，人改为审查AI证据

evidence.quote: Anthropic 今年 5 月每天往代码库里合并大约 2500 次代码变更，到 9 月已经超过 3 万次，涨了十几倍。这么多改动，显然不可能每一行都有人看过。那他们凭什么敢合并？
负责 Claude Code 开发者体验的 Addy Osmani 在这场对谈里讲了他们的做法：每个改动先由 Claude 像真实用户一样实际用一遍、审一遍，发现问题自动修；人不再逐行读代码，而是去看 AI 交上来的证据，比如它在浏览器里点来点去的录屏、在手机和电脑上的截图。
他说他们的审查流程分几步。第一步是让 Claude 先审一遍，关键在于要让它能像真实用户一样把功能实际用一遍：跑端到端测试（从头到尾模拟用户操作的自动化测试），在浏览器里打开页面检查，运行各种工具和代码规范检查，凡是能建立信心的检查都做。
第三步才轮到人，人负责检查 AI 给出的证据。他举的例子是：做一个用户在浏览器里用的界面，就要确认它在浏览器里测过，最好让 AI 生成一段它点来点去的录屏，看完你就有信心说“这个能用”；在意手机或桌面端的体验，就让它给出这些设备上的截图或录屏。他说目标是让 AI 尽可能多地提供验证证据。
